answer: Anchor each agent's voting weight to a reputation root that deepens only at a glacier's pace, earned through independently witnessed work across many epochs and never bought. Every round a Yarrow-style entropy-pooled beacon draws unpredictable live audits, so an operator piloting clones cannot foresee which identity gets probed; correlated non-responses expose the cluster and its shared stake is slashed. One honest node builds slowly while a swarm collapses to a single audited voice.
